description: Two different film endings for SG-1: the Ori war resolved with an ethically complicated device, and the classic team revisited through Ba’al’s historical intervention; with the franchise’s expansion to Atlantis.

related_resources.reason: Regular-series conclusion and altered experience of time on the Odyssey.
First film story, cast, production notes and resolution of the Ori war.
Second film, Ba’al’s altered timeline, the Achilles and Arctic production.
The deliberately different aims of the two films and their scale.
Direct author testimony on ethical doubts about the Ark and the outcome for Morgan.
Contemporary production timeline for SG-1’s finale and both films.
Later retrospective on the economic circumstances of future direct-to-video films.
